observed_problem: Core v2 release_identity currently builds LONGFORM_SPECIAL tags directly from issue_id. Retrospective Period Profiles use internal issue IDs such as SP-2025-H2 while the established public Special identity is the survey slug 2025-H2 (for example tag special/2025-H2 and asset Japanese_Generative_AI_Technical_Survey_Special_2025-H2.pdf). The v2 path would therefore produce special/SP-2025-H2 and an SP-prefixed asset/title for Period editions.
expected_behavior: Internal source issue identity and public publication slug must remain distinct where the repository already distinguishes them. Release identity/title/asset naming must derive from the authoritative Production Profile publication path/slug so Retrospective Period preserves established Special identities while stand-alone Thematic editions such as SP001 remain unchanged.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Derive the public issue slug from the exact Production Profile/survey_root authority carried through the Quality/Publication chain, use it for LONGFORM_SPECIAL release tag/title/asset identity, and add a Period regression preserving special/2025-H2-style identity.
